audience: small business owners and sales or support teams who talk to customers with OpenPhone

useCases.title: Catch up on a text thread with a contact
useCases.text: The AI lists conversations for a number and reads the messages in one thread with text, direction, status and time. It sums up where the talk stands.

useCases.title: Review calls and their next steps
useCases.text: The AI lists calls with a participant and reads one call's AI summary with next steps, or its transcript. You get the result of a call without listening.

useCases.title: Look up a contact
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts and reads one with name, company, role, emails, phone numbers and custom fields.

useCases.title: Send a text message to customers
useCases.text: The AI sends an SMS from one of your OpenPhone numbers to up to 10 recipients. This sends a real text and may cost carrier fees.

useCases.title: Add a new contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact with emails and phone numbers, and can fill custom fields that exist in the workspace.
